newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: YPF officials met Ecuador leader on Maxus.
newsitem.headline: YPF officials met Ecuador leader on Maxus.

text.p: Officials of Argentina's YPF SA met with Ecuadoran President Abdala Bucaram last Friday in talks to reach a joint-venture agreement between YPF's Maxus subsidiary and state-owned Petroecuador, YPF said Monday.

"During (the meeting), goodwill was expressed of both parties to reach an agreement to permit the transformation of the current services contract into a joint-venture contract," YPF said in a letter to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange.

YPF said that Bucaram "manifested Ecuador's interest in foreign investment and at the same time Argentina's YPF SA, as sole owner of Maxus, indicated its wish to stay and invest in Ecuador," YPF said.
Ecuador's government announced last month that it was banning Maxus from continuing its local operations until it reached a production-sharing agreement with Petroecuador.
